decision: The existing EngineeringControl research inspection can be extended to validate source-derived F00-F16 records, but no existing product/build caller consumes its findings. A new M08 fixture or research-check-only probe cannot prove the required per-feature pre-build veto. Do not claim AT-adhd-features-66 complete or admit source changes until a real existing build consumer is identified and its interface is written.

gaps: The current generic decision componentId contract accepts register IDs shaped like M08 and checks aggregate report keys. It does not derive F00-F16 or verify each feature's requirement/quote/grill linkage.
ResearchComponentComparisonV4 is Life Store scoped: inspectResearch rejects V4 records outside the derived Life Store component set. Reusing V4 for ADHD is invalid.

No per-feature acceptance-ID crosswalk is present in the inspected feature trace, register rows, acceptance index, or feature-map entry. Generic membership in acceptance-index would not prove an AT tests that feature.

F00 explicitly says coverage-audit G12 is not the local grill G12. The separate coverage-audit source/namespace is absent from the inspected spec set; do not collapse the two labels or synthesize its evidence.

The register's feature rows include differing/composite release labels. The existing G0:<release>:<component> comparison is component scoped and cannot establish the exact feature release gate by itself.

actualBuildConsumer.consequence: An inspection result or new check method alone is not a per-feature build veto. A real existing consumer path and its source owner are prerequisites; creating a new feature builder/command would invent infrastructure and exceeds this bounded card.

cases.assert: Source readers derive exactly F00-F16 once from the pinned spec/register; missing, duplicate, extra, or mismatched IDs block.
A fixed external overlay with 17 explicitly synthetic records exercises field validation and archive binding; it cannot claim real primary research, native attestation, or global admission.
For each feature, omit only its decision and invoke the actual existing pre-build consumer; assert BLOCKED for that feature and no build artifact/effect.
For each feature, make only its selected option unsupported/nonviable and invoke the actual consumer; assert BLOCKED for that feature and no build artifact/effect.

At CLI, independently omit requirement, quote, grill, primary evidence, compared proven option, each tradeoff, selection, release gate, and feature-linked acceptance ID; require exact missing IDs/findings and feature-specific refusal.
Read indexed report originals/digests and per-feature decisions through the public owner; preserve unresolved facts, report origin, M08/global BLOCKED, acceptanceComplete=false, wholeATsPassed=[].

feasibility.reason: Even the diagnostic contract needs source-derived 17-row/link parsing, an additive public schema, report binding, an AT-66 CLI manifest and feature-map registration. The acceptance's defining proof additionally requires an existing feature build consumer, which is absent, plus an authoritative resolution for F00's separate coverage-audit G12 and feature-to-AT mappings. Implementing a new consumer would be new infrastructure, not a minimum extension.
